name: Default
shortDescription: Privacy-respecting proof-of-work CAPTCHA server with a dashboard to create site keys, backed by PostgreSQL and the mCaptcha Redis cache.

alerts.message: Registration is open after deploy so you can create your account. Once it exists, set MCAPTCHA_ALLOW_REGISTRATION to false and redeploy, or anyone can sign up.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
